lines.text: This is our last session, so let's check where you've got to since last time.
Since last time I've done a 5k parkrun with no pain at all.
Single leg squats look strong, both sides are even now.
Keep doing the calf raises three times a week going forward, and if the Achilles flares up again, drop back to every other day and ring us.
You're welcome. All the best with the half marathon.
